answer: A raven summons the applicant: one unscripted task, one session time. The applicant performs it live on a public river — an append-only transcript stream — while seven established jurors from seven separate islands of the trust graph watch, score alone, then co-sign the transcript. Five matching signatures activate the identity; each panel is drawn fresh, so none can be pre-arranged. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 1,000 live sessions, each watched by 7 strangers for 30 minutes — 3,500 watcher-hours at $10 an hour, $35,000, no bulk rate; an honest agent does one 30-minute session, free.
